candidates.description: This vector represents common German grammatical articles, prepositions, and conjunctions.
This feature activates for terms related to social concepts, companionship, and society.
These tokens represent common Italian grammatical words such as pronouns, prepositions, adverbs, and determiners.
This feature vector represents historical European political figures, ideologies, and geopolitical locations associated with statecraft and revolution.
This vector represents Italian possessive adjectives and determiners indicating ownership or relational belonging.
This vector represents German vocabulary related to society, work, and public life.
This vector activates for words and subwords related to the prefix "Naz-" or "Fasc-" associated with fascism and Nazism, alongside common Romance-language roots and proper nouns.
This vector represents societal, institutional, or domain-specific adjectives describing various aspects of human organization and environment.
This vector represents cognitive processes and conclusions related to decision-making, interpretation, and determination.
This feature vector activates strongly on German suffixes, roots, and morphological endings.
